final.name: Substantive signal density
final.audit_justification: Directly measures how much of the text is new, proposal-specific analysis versus boilerplate, which is a substance judgment.

final.name: Procedural-only request (extension, scheduling, logistics)
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the comment engages substantively with the rule's merits at all versus being purely procedural, which bears directly on substantive quality even though phrased as an extent scale.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction makes the judge read the content and determine whether it engages the rule's provisions on the merits at all, so a high score is direct (negatively signed) evidence about substantive engagement rather than about length, format, or provenance. The proposer's timing-pressure parent tag is not what the text actually asks a judge to detect.
final.upstream_parent: submission-timing pressure on the commenter's internal review process

final.name: Submission apparatus
final.audit_justification: Visible letterhead, addresses, and signatures are a formatting/production fingerprint of the submitter rather than the argument's substance, though such institutional apparatus often comes from the same well-resourced producers who also write substantively stronger comments.
final.upstream_parent: institutional submission infrastructure and process familiarity

final.name: Uncertainty calibration
final.audit_justification: Distinguishing established fact from speculation is a genuine epistemic/reasoning quality.

final.name: Acknowledges both merits and drawbacks
final.audit_justification: Weighing both merits and drawbacks reflects genuine argumentative balance and reasoning quality.

final.name: Coordinated template language
final.audit_justification: Stock/coalition/template language is a coordination and textual-recurrence fingerprint of production rather than substance, and recycled campaign text plausibly signals less original content rather than genuinely better work.

final.name: Personal-experience framing
final.audit_justification: Mere presence of personal circumstances or identity is a self-reference/topic marker distinct from whether that experience strengthens the argument, though the same lived experience can plausibly also ground genuinely substantive first-hand evidence.
final.upstream_parent: author role and access to lived experience

final.name: Sender authority cues
final.audit_justification: Visible titles and credentials are a producer-identity fingerprint rather than argument substance, but credentialed, well-resourced authors plausibly also tend to produce substantively better comments.

final.name: Relevant experiential expertise
final.audit_justification: Requires the commenter's experience to be tied to a concrete, docket-specific observation, which is substantive evidentiary content, not just a credential marker.

final.name: Substance-to-boilerplate ratio
final.audit_justification: Measures the fraction of text that is actual argument versus administrative boilerplate, a direct substance judgment.

final.name: Sheer volume of retained body text
final.audit_justification: Scores raw word/page quantity only and explicitly disclaims judging whether the length is warranted or well used, though sheer volume often correlates with resourced institutional filers who also write substantively deeper comments.
final.upstream_parent: staff time and preparation resources invested in the submission (in-house counsel, consultants, an organization drafting over weeks vs. an individual typing at a keyboard)

final.name: Internally consistent, labeled quantitative detail
final.audit_justification: Whether numeric claims are clearly labeled and internally consistent is a genuine evidentiary-quality property.

final.name: Evidence traceability
final.audit_justification: Requires sources to be identifiable and meaningfully interpreted, a substantive evidence-quality property.

final.name: States core position in opening sentences
final.audit_justification: Where in the document the position appears is a structural/organizational placement choice rather than a measure of the argument's substance, though it may loosely track professionally trained drafters who also write substantively stronger comments.
final.arbiter_reason: The criterion scores where in the document the ask appears, not whether the ask is supported, so a substantively empty comment can score 10 -- indeed the proposer's own exemplar R08 is a bare extension request. Front-loading is a drafting convention that fingerprints trained regulatory-affairs authors, who plausibly also write genuinely stronger comments, hence mixed.

final.name: Claims calibrated to evidence, no leaps
final.audit_justification: Whether claim strength matches evidence strength, avoiding unsupported leaps, is a core reasoning-quality property.

final.name: Text volume
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores quantity of text only, not usefulness or reasoning, duplicating the volume/length dimension of X13, with the same plausible link to resourced producers doing genuinely better work.

final.name: Footnote and formal legal-citation density
final.audit_justification: Scores only the extent of footnote/citation apparatus and explicitly disclaims judging accuracy or persuasiveness, making it a formatting fingerprint, though heavy formal citation apparatus often comes from legal professionals who also produce substantively rigorous arguments.
final.upstream_parent: professional editing / legal training of drafter

final.name: OCR and typographical noise
final.audit_justification: OCR corruption and typographical noise is a pure production/scanning artifact explicitly disclaimed as unrelated to writer competence or quality.

final.name: First-hand operational evidence for claims
final.audit_justification: Requires claims to be concretely grounded in the filer's own direct operational experience, which is substantive evidentiary support.

final.name: Alternative comparison
final.audit_justification: Comparing the proposal to concrete alternatives with explicit tradeoffs is substantive analytical reasoning.

final.name: Concrete organizational standing disclosed
final.audit_justification: Disclosing membership size, mandate, or years of operation establishes the commenter's identity and authority to speak rather than contributing substantive argument about the rule itself, though such standing often belongs to well-resourced organizations that also produce substantively stronger comments.
final.arbiter_reason: Membership counts, statutory mandate, and years of operation are assertions about who is speaking and with what resources, not argument about the rule, which is precisely an upstream-circumstance fingerprint. Well-resourced organizations with real standing often do submit substantively better comments, so the channel is mixed rather than purely spurious.

final.name: Causal impact pathway
final.audit_justification: Tracing the causal mechanism from a provision to specific effects is substantive analytical content.

final.name: Typographic emphasis intensity (all-caps, exclamation marks)
final.audit_justification: All-caps and exclamation-mark emphasis is a typographic/emotional-tone marker explicitly disclaimed as unrelated to persuasive or substantive value, with no plausible link to a genuinely-better-work upstream cause.

final.name: Pinpoint statutory/regulatory citation
final.audit_justification: Requires citations to be precise and accurately applied to the argument, which is substantive legal reasoning, not just citation-format presence.

final.name: Share of the text that is new information rather than restatement
final.audit_justification: Estimates how much of the comment is genuinely new content versus restatement, a direct originality/substance judgment that explicitly discounts length.
